page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.6xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance configured with 24 dedicated virtual CPUs and 96 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture, the instance provides a balanced ratio of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. It operates on a KVM hypervisor platform without attached local storage or bundled dedicated GPUs.

The instance includes an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because local ephemeral storage is not included, persistent block storage must be attached over the network. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance for sustained workloads, while the balanced resource configuration optimizes hardware efficiency by preventing resource over-provisioning.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio and 24 dedicated virtual cores, the ecs.g6.6xlarge instance is suitable for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, microservices architectures, continuous integration pipelines, and medium-scale application backend hosting that relies on network-attached storage.
